reviewed_by: Automated source-semantic review by the delegated coding agent against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 (MCP), Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast
review_basis: The working-tree revision of engine/src/retail/core/app_startup_natives.cpp read for this report hashes to 337c5d5726e7d7ddc366dcece75a990ccdf7b7d436a8cf15a930b12e911dba3a and its header hashes to 790a989331d01be1a96fe9e7136374f2f524d6f5f216a9f3e1a534c0ad026b50; both are the digests bound here. The report was rebound after the sibling fix that corrected the shared file's 0x0048F0B0 getter to read a distinct AppTitle global (retail 0x005C8BD4) instead of the InstanceHandle global; the StoreCommandLine body below is unchanged from the earlier review. The retail body was re-disassembled and re-decompiled through the live Binary Ninja MCP view, re-recovered through Radare2 6.2.0, and independently recovered by angr CFGFast at the exact entry. This report supersedes earlier reviews bound to 281a6628..., which is no longer the current source.

candidate_semantics.function: char const* IGI_RETAIL_CDECL StoreCommandLine(char const* command_line) { CommandLine = command_line; return command_line; }
candidate_semantics.behavior: One cdecl pointer argument. The assignment writes the 4-byte argument value into the 4-byte global CommandLine; the return statement leaves the same 32-bit value in EAX. No branch, call, arithmetic or floating-point operation.

global.candidate_image_note: Previous linked candidate image; it predates the AppTitle global added by the 0x0048F0B0 fix, so its .bss offsets are historical and the current source has not been relinked.

The current digest is 337c5d5726e7d7ddc366dcece75a990ccdf7b7d436a8cf15a930b12e911dba3a and the body still performs exactly the retail store-then-return; only the shared .bss layout changed (AppTitle .bss+0, InstanceHandle .bss+4, CommandLine .bss+8 in the fresh object), so this evidence is rebound to the current revision.

runtime_contract.execution_status: not_executed; this is a declared observation contract for a future paired retail/candidate capture, not runtime evidence
runtime_contract.note: The contract requires retail and the staged candidate to be observed through the same probe before their primary thread resumes. Pointer values are process-local, so it compares designated text and typed relations rather than raw addresses. No such capture has been run for this record.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja, Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast each recover exactly one function at 0x0048F0C0 spanning 10 bytes with 3 instructions, one basic block and no edges. The current translation unit defines exactly one function for this address, StoreCommandLine.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads its only argument from [esp+4] as a 32-bit value. The only call site is 0x0048F5F4 in main 0x0048F530, where 0x0048F5EC loads [esp+0x480] (WinMain's lpCmdLine after the frame/pushes) into ECX and 0x0048F5F3 pushes it. Binary Ninja's prototype is cdecl int32_t(int32_t). The candidate declares char const* __cdecl(char const*), so it consumes the same one pointer-width argument at [esp+4] and reads it; the pointer type is the ABI-adapted interpretation recorded in the manifest.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The only retail constants are the cdecl argument offset and the absolute global address 0x005C8BC8 encoded in a3c88b5c00. There is no scaling, arithmetic or index computation. The candidate body contains no source constant; the store address is the linker relocation of the CommandLine symbol.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail performs exactly one 4-byte store to 0x005C8BC8 and reads no global. The current candidate performs exactly one 4-byte store of the argument to the 4-byte global CommandLine; the fresh -O3 object encodes the store as mov %eax,<dir32 .bss+8> (CommandLine). The previous linked image 596d15c4... placed CommandLine at 0x005D5BBC, but it predates the AppTitle global added by the sibling 0x0048F0B0 fix and the current source has not been relinked, so no current link-time VA is claimed. Access width and kind match, and the body touches no other memory.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail has no calls and no branches; its only side effect is the 4-byte store to 0x005C8BC8. The candidate is a single assignment to CommandLine followed by a return: it calls nothing and writes nothing else. The runtime contract declares the store observables.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail's only path leaves the argument bits in EAX after the store, so the return value is the argument bit-for-bit; there is no error branch. The candidate returns command_line, the same value it stored. A fresh -O3 compile of the current translation unit produced exactly mov 0x4(%esp),%eax; mov %eax,<relocated CommandLine>; ret (object e2dad9571a80b7071a3e179419dbf35febaf29ecc36faec0851142a12dc73883, 10 bytes), and the 10-case Radare2-ESIL/host differential in scripts/native_diff_runner.py passed 10/10 on this revision.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The body performs no floating-point load, store or arithmetic and reads no FPU state.

limitations: The reviewed scope is the single observed retail path; the function has no alternate or error path.

The CFG evidence recorded for this native is retail-image structure: Binary Ninja and Radare2 independently recover the same one-block graph from igi.exe. The cfg_similarity value of 1.0 is the agreement of those two retail graphs, not a candidate-versus-retail score.

Candidate structural equivalence rests on the identical one-block load/store/return shape (verified in the linked candidate image and the fresh -O3 object) and the 10-case retail-vs-candidate differential in scripts/native_diff_runner.py, not on a paired runtime capture. A paired typed Frida capture of retail igi.exe and the staged candidate is still outstanding; this record does not claim runtime equivalence.

The candidate stores to its own mapped CommandLine global rather than retail 0x005C8BC8. The previous linked image 596d15c4... placed it at 0x005D5BBC, but the current source (which now also defines AppTitle) has not been relinked; the manifest runtime_layout maps retail 0x005C8BC8 to the candidate CommandLine symbol, and this review does not establish process-wide memory-layout equivalence.

The behavioral differential executes the retail bytes in the Radare2 ESIL emulator and the candidate as a host-built translation unit; neither game process was launched. It is not a live IGI.exe observation.
This review checks source semantics, not byte identity. The compiled instruction sequence is recorded separately in the build report.

The shared translation unit also implements 0x0048F0B0 and 0x0048F0D0. The 0x0048F0B0 fix added the AppTitle .bss symbol, which changes link-time offsets of the other globals; those siblings have their own records and are not claimed here.
